messages:
Kai: heads up — AWQ INT8 bakeoff for orca-13b is regressing on vLLM+Triton path on h100s, reproducing on two clusters :frowning:
Sam: ugh, what error/behavior are you seeing? latency or accuracy?
Kai: accuracy. fast local runs (vLLM only) match reference FP16 within 0.6% but when routed through Triton plugin accuracy drops ~3.7% on LAMBADA and we see softmax distortions in logits.
Ana: can you paste the failing log chunk? also which driver/container?
Kai: container: rwinf/inference:prod-2026-03-01, CUDA 12.2, nvidia-driver 545.xx, triton 2.45. Example snippet:

```
[triton_backend] WARNING: kernel selection fallback: selected kernel mismatch for layer 17
runtime_error: kernel_assert: dequant_scale <= 0 || isfinite(dequant_scale)
Model output mismatch: max_abs_diff=0.0037, relative_mse=0.0021
```

Sam: that kernel_assert about dequant_scale looks like a symbol/version mismatch — we saw similar when libcuda/driver headers changed between 545 and 550.
Prasad: is Triton using a vendor-provided plugin (trtllm) or our custom awq shim?
Kai: using vendor trtllm plugin + awq-weights produced by our preprocess. The weird bit: same plugin + weights on A100 (CUDA11.8) is fine. Only failing on H100/CUDA12.2 with Triton loaded.
Ana: could be the Triton->vLLM routing path that reorders kv/cache buffers, changing quantization alignment. Any pattern in which prompts fail?
Kai: mostly long-context prompts (>=1024). Short prompts pass. Also observed non-deterministic token spikes — sometimes first token logits are fine then later diverge.
Tanya: can you repro with `TRITONSERVER_BACKEND_PRELOAD=0` or disabling dlopen behaviour? sometimes dlopen order picks up an older libnvrtc.
Kai: tried `LD_PRELOAD` hacks, no dice. But switching triton to our internal awq shim (disabled trtllm plugin) makes it pass on the same h100 nodes.
Prasad: that narrows it: trtllm plugin + awq quant path on CUDA12 picks a different kernel variant that mishandles int8->fp32 scale pipeline. Maybe a kernel registration collision.
Sam: assign to kernel-team and trtllm vendor. Can you upload minimal reproducer + the exact model weights and a short prompt set? CI-bot: attached artifacts accepted — link: s3://rwinf-test/artifacts/2246789012/orca-awq-repro.tar.gz :white_check_mark:
Kai: thanks — repro uploaded. For now workaround: fall back to vLLM-only serving for orca-13b AWQ on CUDA12/h100. Also adding an eval gate in the deploy config to block the triton route for that model.
Ana: add a small regression test that runs LAMBADA and a few long prompts at rollout time, fail fast if delta > 1.5%.
Tanya: noted — I'll add the deploy guard and ping vendor with kernel logs.
Prasad: +1 on vendor ticket, include symbol versions from `ldd` on the trtllm plugin and `nm -D` on the runtime libs.
Kai: thanks all — I'll follow up with perf traces and a short diff showing where outputs diverge. :eyes:
